summary.ru: Предлог в устойчивом выражении нельзя угадать по смыслу — его нужно запоминать: in the end, on time, by mistake, at least, in charge of.
summary.en: The preposition in a fixed expression cannot be guessed from the meaning — it has to be learnt: in the end, on time, by mistake, at least, in charge of.

heading.ru: In the end, at least, in fact: устойчивые фразы
heading.en: In the end, at least, in fact: fixed phrases

body.ru: In the end подводит итог, а at the end указывает на конец конкретного события. At least ограничивает минимальную величину, in fact уточняет или поправляет сказанное. Предлог в каждом выражении фиксирован. For example вводит пример, on the other hand противопоставляет аргументы, in general обобщает, by the way добавляет замечание.
body.en: In the end sums up a result, while at the end refers to the end of a particular event. At least sets a minimum, and in fact corrects or clarifies what was said. The preposition is fixed in each expression. For example introduces an example, on the other hand contrasts arguments, in general generalises, and by the way adds a remark.

examples: In the end, they agreed to help us.
At least ten people came to the meeting.
In fact, the shop is closed today.
On the other hand, the hotel was very expensive.
In general, the food here is quite cheap.

body.ru: On time значит «точно по расписанию», без опоздания. In time значит «достаточно рано», с запасом до срока. Разница в точке отсчёта: on time — назначенный момент по расписанию, in time — запас времени до срока.
body.en: On time means exactly as scheduled, without being late. In time means early enough, with spare time before a deadline. The difference is the reference point: on time matches the scheduled moment, whereas in time means there is spare time before the deadline.

examples: The train left on time at 7:45.
We got home just in time for dinner.
The meeting started on time.
The parcel arrived in time for her birthday.

heading.ru: By mistake, by chance, on purpose, in advance: устойчивые выражения
heading.en: By mistake, by chance, on purpose, in advance

body.ru: By mistake значит «по ошибке», by chance — «случайно», on purpose — «нарочно», in advance — «заранее». Предлог в этих выражениях фиксирован, поэтому заменять его нельзя.
body.en: By mistake means accidentally, by chance without planning, on purpose deliberately, and in advance beforehand. The preposition is fixed in each expression and cannot be replaced.

examples: I pressed the wrong button by mistake.
She saw him by chance at the market.
She switched off the light on purpose.
Please let me know in advance.

heading.ru: Under control и in charge of
heading.en: Under control and in charge of

body.ru: Under control описывает ситуацию, которой управляют, а in charge of — человека, который отвечает за дело или руководит им. At the moment указывает на текущий момент.
body.en: Under control describes a situation that is being managed, while in charge of describes the person responsible for or leading something. At the moment means right now.

examples: The fire was soon under control.
The disease is now under control.
My sister is in charge of the shop.
Who is in charge of this project?
She is working in Berlin at the moment.

title.ru: Тонкие случаи: by / with / in, during / for, between / among
title.en: Advanced contrasts: by / with / in, during / for, between / among

summary.ru: Тонкие различия в употреблении предлогов: by / with / in, during / for / while, between / among, except / besides, by the time и предлоги в вопросах.
summary.en: Subtle distinctions in preposition use: by / with / in, during / for / while, between / among, except / besides, by the time and prepositions in questions.

heading.ru: By, with, in: способ, инструмент, материал
heading.en: By, with, in: method, instrument, material

body.ru: By вводит способ или вид транспорта, with — инструмент, in — материал или среду. Перед видом транспорта артикль не ставится, а пешком говорят on foot.
body.en: By introduces a method or a means of transport, with an instrument, and in a material or medium. Transport phrases take no article, and walking is expressed by the fixed phrase on foot.

examples: He goes to the gym by bus.
He fixed the chair with a hammer.
The walls were painted in bright colours.
The village is easy to reach on foot.

heading.ru: During, for, while: период, длительность, придаточное

body.ru: During стоит перед существительным и называет событие или период. For указывает длительность. While вводит придаточное предложение с подлежащим и глаголом.
body.en: During comes before a noun and names an event or period. For states a length of time. While introduces a clause with its own subject and verb.

examples: There was a power cut during the storm.
They lived in Rome for two weeks.
While she was studying, her brother was playing games.
The audience was silent during the performance.

body.ru: Between связывает отдельные объекты, обычно два. Among — положение внутри группы. Except исключает предмет, besides добавляет его к уже названным.
body.en: Between links separate items, usually two. Among describes position inside a group. Except leaves something out, and besides adds it to what has been mentioned.

examples: The café is between the bakery and the bookshop.
Among other things, the museum has a fine map collection.
I like all vegetables except tomatoes.
Besides the guitar, he also plays the drums.

heading.ru: By the time и предлоги в вопросах
heading.en: By the time and prepositions in questions

body.ru: By the time вводит момент, к которому завершится действие, поэтому в главной части часто нужны совершенные времена. В вопросах предлог может стоять в конце предложения.
body.en: By the time introduces the moment by which an action is completed, so perfect tenses are common in the main clause. In questions, the preposition may come at the end of the sentence.

examples: By the time she called, I had finished dinner.
By the time you finish, it will be dark.
Who is this letter from?
What are you looking for?

questions.sentence: We tried three different plans, but ___ the end we chose the simplest one.

translation.ru: Мы попробовали три разных плана, но в конце концов выбрали самый простой.

explanation.ru: In the end = «в конце концов, в итоге» — устойчивое выражение без дополнения. At the end обычно относится к концу конкретного события: at the end of the film.
explanation.en: In the end means 'finally, after all' and is used without a complement. At the end usually refers to the end of a particular event: at the end of the film.

questions.sentence: The project looked impossible at first, but ___ the end it was a great success.

translation.ru: Сначала проект казался невыполнимым, но в итоге оказался очень успешным.

explanation.ru: In the end = «в итоге»: проект сначала казался невозможным, но результат оказался успешным. At the end обычно требует уточнения: at the end of the project.
explanation.en: In the end means 'after all, finally': the project seemed impossible at first but succeeded in the end. At the end usually needs a complement: at the end of the project.

questions.sentence: It will take ___ least two hours to drive there.

translation.ru: Дорога туда займёт как минимум два часа.

explanation.ru: At least = «как минимум, по меньшей мере» — устойчивое сочетание с предлогом at.
explanation.en: At least means 'no less than' — a fixed expression with at.

questions.sentence: He looks quite young, but ___ fact he is over forty.

translation.ru: Он выглядит довольно молодым, но на самом деле ему больше сорока.

explanation.ru: In fact = «на самом деле, фактически» — устойчивое выражение с предлогом in.
explanation.en: In fact means 'actually' — a fixed expression with in.

questions.sentence: Some animals, ___ example dolphins, are extremely intelligent.

translation.ru: Некоторые животные, например дельфины, чрезвычайно умны.

explanation.ru: For example = «например»; предлог for в этом выражении фиксирован.
explanation.en: For example introduces an example; the preposition for is fixed.

questions.sentence: This flat is cheaper; ___ the other hand, it is further from the centre.

translation.ru: Эта квартира дешевле; с другой стороны, она дальше от центра.

explanation.ru: On the other hand = «с другой стороны»: противопоставление. Устойчивое сочетание с предлогом on.
explanation.en: On the other hand introduces a contrasting point. The expression always uses on.

questions.sentence: The new system saves time; ___ the other hand, it is expensive to maintain.

translation.ru: Новая система экономит время; с другой стороны, её дорого обслуживать.

explanation.ru: On the other hand вводит противоположный аргумент; сочетание с on устойчивое.
explanation.en: On the other hand introduces the opposing argument. The expression is fixed with on.

questions.sentence: I picked up your umbrella ___ mistake because it looks just like mine.

translation.ru: Я взял твой зонт по ошибке, потому что он выглядит точно как мой.

explanation.ru: By mistake = «по ошибке, случайно». Устойчивое выражение с by; on purpose — его антоним.
explanation.en: By mistake means 'accidentally'. The fixed expression uses by; its opposite is on purpose.

questions.sentence: We met ___ chance at the airport and had a long chat.

translation.ru: Мы случайно встретились в аэропорту и долго разговаривали.

explanation.ru: By chance = «случайно»: встреча произошла без плана. Устойчивое выражение с by.
explanation.en: By chance means 'accidentally, without planning'. The expression uses by.

questions.sentence: You should book the tickets ___ advance if you want good seats.

translation.ru: Тебе стоит забронировать билеты заранее, если хочешь хорошие места.

explanation.ru: In advance = «заранее»: действие до нужного момента. Устойчивое выражение с in.
explanation.en: In advance means 'beforehand'. The expression uses in.

questions.sentence: I'm sorry — I didn't break the glass ___ purpose.

translation.ru: Прости — я не нарочно разбил стакан.

explanation.ru: On purpose = «нарочно, специально»; в отрицании — didn't do it on purpose. Предлог on фиксирован.
explanation.en: On purpose means 'deliberately'. The preposition on is fixed.

questions.sentence: The police soon had the crowd ___ control.

translation.ru: Полиция быстро взяла толпу под контроль.

explanation.ru: Under control = «под контролем»: ситуация управляема. In control значит «управляет, имеет власть» (о человеке).
explanation.en: Under control means 'contained or managed'. In control means 'having power' and describes a person.

questions.sentence: My uncle is ___ charge of the sales team.

translation.ru: Мой дядя отвечает за отдел продаж.

explanation.ru: In charge of = «отвечает за, руководит»: устойчивое выражение с in. Формальный вариант — under the charge of somebody.
explanation.en: In charge of means 'responsible for'. The expression is fixed with in; under the charge of is formal and needs an article.

questions.sentence: Our bus left ___ time at exactly 8:15 this morning.

translation.ru: Наш автобус отправился вовремя, ровно в 8:15.

explanation.ru: On time = точно по расписанию, в назначенное время: автобус отправился ровно в 8:15. In time значило бы «успел до срока» и здесь не подходит.
explanation.en: On time means 'exactly as scheduled': the bus left at exactly 8:15. In time would mean 'early enough for something' and does not fit here.

questions.sentence: We ran to the platform and got there just ___ time to catch the train.

translation.ru: Мы побежали на платформу и добрались туда как раз вовремя, чтобы успеть на поезд.

explanation.ru: In time = «успеть до срока, в последний момент»: just in time to catch the train. On time означало бы «точно по расписанию» и не подходит к «успеть на поезд».
explanation.en: In time means 'early enough, just before it is too late': just in time to catch the train. On time would mean 'punctually' and does not fit the purpose here.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте устойчивое выражение и предложение с ним.
prompt.en: Match each fixed expression with the sentence that uses it.

left.ru: in the end — в конце концов

pairs.right: In the end, we sold the old house.
The journey takes at least three hours by bus.
He paid for the wrong ticket by mistake.
The best seats are usually sold in advance.

explanation.ru: In the end = «в конце концов», at least = «как минимум», by mistake = «по ошибке», in advance = «заранее» — предлоги в этих выражениях фиксированы.
explanation.en: In the end means 'finally', at least means 'no less than', by mistake means 'accidentally', and in advance means 'beforehand' — the prepositions are fixed.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте устойчивое выражение и предложение с ним.
prompt.en: Match each fixed expression with the sentence that uses it.

pairs.right: The guests arrived on time for once.

left.ru: in time — до срока, с запасом

pairs.right: We arrived at the airport in time for our flight.
The film was, in fact, rather boring.

left.ru: on the other hand — с другой стороны
left.en: on the other hand — from another point of view

pairs.right: The flat is small; on the other hand, it is very central.

explanation.ru: On time = «точно по расписанию», in time = «до срока, с запасом», in fact = «на самом деле», on the other hand = «с другой стороны».
explanation.en: On time means 'exactly as scheduled', in time means 'early enough', in fact means 'actually', and on the other hand introduces a contrasting point.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте устойчивое выражение и предложение с ним.
prompt.en: Match each fixed expression with the sentence that uses it.

pairs.right: Take London, for example — it is full of museums.
I found this old photo by chance.
She left the door open on purpose.
The fire was brought under control within an hour.

explanation.ru: For example = «например», by chance = «случайно», on purpose = «нарочно», under control = «под контролем».
explanation.en: For example means 'for instance', by chance means 'by accident', on purpose means 'deliberately', and under control means 'being managed'.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте устойчивое выражение и предложение с ним.
prompt.en: Match each fixed expression with the sentence that uses it.

pairs.right: Her cousin is in charge of the warehouse.

left.ru: at the moment — в данный момент

pairs.right: At the moment, I am staying with my parents.
In general, people here are very friendly.
By the way, the meeting starts at ten.

explanation.ru: In charge of = «отвечает за», at the moment = «в данный момент», in general = «в целом», by the way = «кстати».
explanation.en: In charge of means 'responsible for', at the moment means 'right now', in general means 'generally', and by the way adds an incidental remark.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте устойчивое выражение и предложение с ним.
prompt.en: Match each fixed expression with a sentence.

left.ru: in the end — итог (сравните: at the end of the film)
left.en: in the end — a result (cf. at the end of the film)

pairs.right: After weeks of discussion, we chose the seaside in the end.

left.ru: on time — точно по расписанию (не in time)
left.en: on time — exactly as scheduled (not in time)

pairs.right: The 7:20 train to York left on time this morning.

left.ru: by chance — случайно, не on purpose
left.en: by chance — without planning (not on purpose)

pairs.right: I came across this old map by chance in a bookshop.

left.ru: in charge of — отвечает за (не under control)
left.en: in charge of — responsible for (not under control)

pairs.right: The assistant manager is in charge of the new café.

explanation.ru: Пятая пара противопоставляет похожие выражения: in the end / at the end, on time / in time, by chance / on purpose, in charge of / under control.
explanation.en: The pairs contrast similar expressions: in the end / at the end, on time / in time, by chance / on purpose, in charge of / under control.

questions.sentence: The shop is closed ___ the moment.

translation.ru: Магазин сейчас закрыт.

explanation.ru: At the moment — «в данный момент»; устойчивое выражение с предлогом at.
explanation.en: At the moment means right now; the expression is fixed with at.

questions.sentence: The trains in this country are, ___ general, quite punctual.

translation.ru: Поезда в этой стране в целом довольно пунктуальны.

explanation.ru: In general — «в целом, обычно»; устойчивое выражение с предлогом in.
explanation.en: In general means mostly or usually; the expression is fixed with in.

questions.sentence: Oh, ___ the way, your parcel arrived this morning.

translation.ru: Кстати, твоя посылка пришла сегодня утром.

explanation.ru: By the way — «кстати»; вводная фраза с предлогом by.
explanation.en: By the way means incidentally; the phrase is fixed with by.

questions.sentence: ___ example, oak trees can live for centuries.

translation.ru: Например, дубы могут жить веками.

explanation.ru: For example — «например»; связка, которая всегда пишется с for.
explanation.en: For example introduces an illustration; the phrase is fixed with for.

questions.sentence: The repairs will cost ___ least five hundred pounds.

translation.ru: Ремонт обойдётся как минимум в пятьсот фунтов.

explanation.ru: At least — «как минимум, по меньшей мере»; устойчивое выражение с at.
explanation.en: At least means no less than; the fixed expression uses at.

questions.sentence: I thought the task would be easy; ___ fact, it took me all day.

translation.ru: Я думал, задание будет лёгким; на самом деле оно заняло у меня весь день.

explanation.ru: In fact — «на самом деле»; устойчивое выражение с предлогом in.
explanation.en: In fact means actually; the fixed expression uses in.

questions.sentence: Thanks to the new timetable, the buses now run ___ time.

translation.ru: Благодаря новому расписанию автобусы теперь ходят вовремя.

explanation.ru: On time — «точно по расписанию»; устойчивое выражение с предлогом on.
explanation.en: On time means exactly as scheduled; the fixed expression uses on.

questions.sentence: The doctors saved his sight just ___ time.

translation.ru: Врачи спасли ему зрение в самый последний момент.

explanation.ru: In time — «вовремя, до наступления срока»; just in time значит «в самый последний момент». On time означало бы «точно по расписанию» и здесь не подходит.
explanation.en: In time means before it is too late; just in time means at the last possible moment. On time would mean exactly as scheduled and does not fit here.

questions.sentence: He deleted the message ___ purpose to test the backup.

translation.ru: Он нарочно удалил сообщение, чтобы проверить резервную копию.

explanation.ru: On purpose — «нарочно»; устойчивое выражение с предлогом on.
explanation.en: On purpose means deliberately; the fixed expression uses on.

questions.sentence: The pilot soon had the plane ___ control.

translation.ru: Пилот быстро взял самолёт под контроль.

explanation.ru: Under control — «под контролем»; устойчивое выражение с предлогом under.
explanation.en: Under control means being managed; the fixed expression uses under.

questions.sentence: My parents travelled to the coast ___ train last weekend.

translation.ru: В прошлые выходные мои родители ездили к морю на поезде.

explanation.ru: By + вид транспорта без артикля: by train, by bus, by car. С артиклем было бы on the train / in the car.
explanation.en: By + means of transport without an article: by train, by bus, by car. With an article we would say on the train or in the car.

questions.sentence: We spent the whole day exploring the old town ___ foot.

translation.ru: Мы провели весь день, гуляя по старому городу пешком.

explanation.ru: On foot = «пешком» — исключение: с другими видами транспорта ставим by (by bus, by train), но пешком только on foot.
explanation.en: On foot is the fixed exception: other means of transport take by (by bus, by train), but walking is on foot.

questions.sentence: He opened the tin ___ a pocket knife.

translation.ru: Он открыл банку перочинным ножом.

explanation.ru: With + инструмент, которым пользуются: with a knife, with a spoon. By вводит способ (by hand), а не предмет.
explanation.en: With + the instrument used: with a knife, with a spoon. By introduces a method (by hand), not a tool.

questions.sentence: The teacher asked us to write the essay ___ pencil.

translation.ru: Учитель попросил нас написать сочинение карандашом.

explanation.ru: In + материал или среда письма: in pencil, in ink. С инструментом было бы with a pencil.
explanation.en: In + the medium: in pencil, in ink. With an instrument we would say with a pencil.

questions.sentence: The portrait was painted ___ oils.

translation.ru: Портрет был написан масляными красками.

explanation.ru: In oils = «маслом, масляными красками»: in + материал или техника (in oils, in watercolour).
explanation.en: In oils names the medium: in oils, in watercolour. In is the preposition for the material or technique of a painting.

questions.sentence: We stayed with my aunt ___ ten days.

translation.ru: Мы гостили у тёти десять дней.

explanation.ru: For + длительность: for two weeks, for five years. During требует существительного-события: during the holidays.
explanation.en: For + length of time: for two weeks, for five years. During needs an event noun: during the holidays.

questions.sentence: I fell asleep twice ___ the film.

translation.ru: Я дважды заснул во время фильма.

explanation.ru: During + существительное-событие: during the film, during the lesson. For с длительностью здесь не подходит.
explanation.en: During + event noun: during the film, during the lesson. For + duration does not fit here.

questions.sentence: He has worked in this office ___ five years.

translation.ru: Он работает в этом офисе пять лет.

explanation.ru: For five years = «пять лет» (длительность). During five years не говорят: нужен артикль и событие — during those five years.
explanation.en: For five years expresses duration. During five years is not used; with during we need an article and an event: during those five years.

questions.sentence: The hotel stands ___ the station and the river.

translation.ru: Отель стоит между вокзалом и рекой.

explanation.ru: Between — между двумя предметами: between the station and the river. Among — среди группы из трёх и более.
explanation.en: Between is used for two things: between the station and the river. Among is for a group of three or more.

questions.sentence: ___ other things, she is a talented photographer.

translation.ru: Среди прочего она талантливый фотограф.

explanation.ru: Among other things = «среди прочего, помимо всего прочего» — устойчивое выражение с among (группа, множество).
explanation.en: Among other things means 'as well as other things' — a fixed expression with among for a group.

questions.sentence: The museum is open every day ___ Monday.

translation.ru: Музей открыт каждый день, кроме понедельника.

explanation.ru: Except = «за исключением»: музей открыт каждый день, но понедельник — исключение. Besides = «вдобавок, помимо», здесь это противоречило бы every day.
explanation.en: Except means 'not including': the museum is open every day, but Monday is the exception. Besides means 'in addition to' and would contradict every day.

questions.sentence: ___ the piano, she also plays the violin.

translation.ru: Помимо пианино, она ещё играет на скрипке.

explanation.ru: Besides = «кроме, в дополнение к»: besides the piano — в дополнение к пианино. Слово also подсказывает, что речь о добавлении.
explanation.en: Besides means 'in addition to': besides the piano = in addition to the piano. Also shows that something is being added.

questions.sentence: ___ the time we got to the station, the train had already left.

translation.ru: К тому времени, когда мы добрались до вокзала, поезд уже ушёл.

explanation.ru: By the time = «к тому моменту, когда»: после него обычно Past Perfect (had left). Предлог by связывает момент с завершённым действием.
explanation.en: By the time means 'at or before the moment when'. It is followed by a Past Perfect here (had left); by links the point in time to a completed action.

questions.sentence: Who are you waiting ___?

translation.ru: Кого ты ждёшь?

explanation.ru: Wait for somebody = «ждать кого-то»; в вопросе предлог for остаётся в конце: Who are you waiting for?
explanation.en: Wait for somebody: in a question the preposition for stays at the end — Who are you waiting for?

questions.sentence: Which platform does the train to Oxford leave ___?

translation.ru: С какой платформы отправляется поезд в Оксфорд?

explanation.ru: Leave from a platform = «отправляться с платформы»; в вопросе предлог from остаётся в конце.
explanation.en: Leave from a platform: the preposition from stays at the end of the question.

prompt.en: Match each category with its example.

pairs.right: My father always travels to London by train.
She cut the cake with a silver knife.
The contract was signed in black ink.
The old town is best explored on foot.

explanation.ru: By — вид транспорта (by train), with — инструмент (with a knife), in — материал (in ink), а пешком — on foot.
explanation.en: By is for transport (by train), with for an instrument (with a knife), in for a material (in ink), and walking is on foot.

prompt.en: Match each category with its example.

pairs.right: Many people fell asleep during the lecture.
He has been learning Chinese for three years.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.

left.ru: by the time + Past Perfect — к тому моменту, когда

pairs.right: By the time she was thirty, she had visited twenty countries.

explanation.ru: During + событие, for + длительность, while + придаточное предложение, by the time + Past Perfect.
explanation.en: During + event, for + duration, while + clause, by the time + Past Perfect.

prompt.en: Match each category with its example.

pairs.right: The post office is between the bank and the cinema.
He was the youngest among the finalists.
No one except the manager knew the password.
Besides English, she speaks French and German.

explanation.ru: Between — между двумя, among — среди группы, except — за исключением, besides — в дополнение.
explanation.en: Between is for two things, among for a group, except means 'not including', besides means 'in addition to'.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте вопрос и предлог в конце.
prompt.en: Match each question with its final preposition.

pairs.right: Who did you go to the cinema with?
What did you buy this for?
Which platform does the coach to Bath leave from?
What are you talking about?

explanation.ru: В вопросах предлог остаётся в конце: who … with, what … for, which platform … from, what … about.
explanation.en: In questions the preposition stays at the end: who … with, what … for, which platform … from, what … about.

prompt.en: Match each category with an example.

pairs.right: They usually travel to the islands by ferry.

left.en: with + instrument — a tool, not by

pairs.right: The baker opened the bag with a small knife.

left.ru: during + событие — событие, не for + длительность
left.en: during + event — an event, not for + duration

pairs.right: Someone's phone rang twice during the ceremony.
The shop is open daily except Wednesday.

explanation.ru: Пары противопоставляют предлоги: by и with, during и for, except и besides.
explanation.en: The pairs contrast the prepositions: by and with, during and for, except and besides.

questions.sentence: They travelled to the remote village ___ boat.

translation.ru: Они добрались до отдалённой деревни на лодке.

explanation.ru: By + вид транспорта: by boat, by bus. Артикль перед транспортом не ставится.
explanation.en: By + means of transport: by boat, by bus. No article before transport.

questions.sentence: The post office is only ten minutes ___ foot from here.

translation.ru: Почта отсюда всего в десяти минутах пешком.

explanation.ru: On foot — «пешком»; устойчивое выражение с on, а не by.
explanation.en: On foot means walking; the fixed expression uses on, not by.

questions.sentence: He broke the window ___ a cricket ball.

translation.ru: Он разбил окно крикетным мячом.

explanation.ru: With + инструмент: with a cricket ball. С инструментом в активной конструкции используем with, а by указывает на исполнителя в пассиве: the window was broken by a cricket ball.
explanation.en: With + instrument: with a cricket ball. In an active sentence we use with; by marks the agent in a passive sentence: the window was broken by a cricket ball.

questions.sentence: The notice was printed ___ large green letters.

translation.ru: Объявление было напечатано крупными зелёными буквами.

explanation.ru: In + материал или среда: in large green letters, in ink, in pencil.
explanation.en: In + material or medium: in large green letters, in ink, in pencil.

questions.sentence: The baby woke up three times ___ the night.

translation.ru: Малыш просыпался три раза за ночь.

explanation.ru: During + существительное-событие: during the night. For означало бы длительность, а здесь важны повторяющиеся моменты.
explanation.en: During + a noun (an event or period): during the night. For would state a length of time, while here the repeated moments matter.

questions.sentence: They waited at the airport ___ three hours.

translation.ru: Они прождали в аэропорту три часа.

explanation.ru: For + длительность: for three hours. Предлог for отвечает на вопрос «как долго».
explanation.en: For + a length of time: for three hours; it answers the question how long.

questions.sentence: There is a low fence ___ the two gardens.

translation.ru: Между двумя садами есть низкий забор.

explanation.ru: Between — между отдельными объектами, здесь их два. Among — для группы.
explanation.en: Between is for separate items, usually two. Among is used for a group.

questions.sentence: The winner was chosen ___ more than a hundred contestants.

translation.ru: Победителя выбрали среди более чем ста участников.

explanation.ru: Among — «среди группы»; between требует отдельных объектов, обычно двух.
explanation.en: Among means inside a group; between requires separate items, usually two.

questions.sentence: The hotel serves breakfast to all guests ___ those leaving early.

translation.ru: Отель подаёт завтрак всем гостям, кроме тех, кто уезжает рано.

explanation.ru: Except — «за исключением»; besides означало бы «в дополнение к».
explanation.en: Except means not including; besides would mean in addition to.

questions.sentence: What is this strange noise coming ___?

translation.ru: Откуда доносится этот странный шум?

explanation.ru: В вопросах предлог часто стоит в конце: coming from. From указывает на источник.
explanation.en: In questions the preposition often comes at the end: coming from. From points to the source.
